claims: Justin Bieber is headlining Saturday night at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.
Justin Bieber is performing on April 11 and April 18, 2026, at 11:25 p.m. PT.
Justin Bieber's performances at Coachella 2026 are on Saturday, April 11, and Saturday, April 18, 2026.
Justin Bieber's set time at Coachella 2026 is 11:25 PM PDT.
Justin Bieber's stage at Coachella 2026 is Main Stage (Coachella Stage).
This is Justin Bieber's first major festival headlining set since 2022.
Reports indicate a record-breaking payment of over $10 million.
This is Justin Bieber's debut as a billed Coachella headliner.
Justin Bieber has been on a hiatus from large-scale performances since 2022.
Reports suggest Justin Bieber's setlist at Coachella 2026 includes a blend of new "Swag" project songs and classics like "Sorry," "Baby," and "Where Are Ü Now," based on heard soundchecks.
The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival lineup includes Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G.
The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is sold out.
